y-m-68-03.material:
Umsebenzi f uyahlukaniseka kuwo onke amanani okwenyani, yaye f'(x) > 0 kwi-x nganye. Ngoko i-f inomsebenzi ojikelezileyo g, yaye i-g nayo iyahlukaniseka. Oko kukuthi, g(f(x)) = x kwi-x nganye. Umfundi ubhale amaxabiso aziwayo e-f kumakhadi ukuze afumane ixabiso le-g'(3). Onke amakhadi ziinyaniso.
Ikhadi ① f(1) = 3
Ikhadi ② f'(1) = 5
Ikhadi ③ f'(3) = 29
Ikhadi ④ f(3) = 33
Ifomyula ayaziwa, yaye kukho ezi ngcaciso zine kuphela. (Funda: f prime ye-1, g prime ye-3.)

y-m-68-06.topic: Iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokwahlula: ukugweba iifomyula ezimbini ze-derivative ye-x^x usebenzisa ubungqina
y-m-68-06.goal: Funda ityala apho idatha yamanani kwiphuzu elinye ingenakuhlula iifomyula ezimbini ze-derivative, yenza umzekelo ochasayo ococa ifomyula engalunganga usebenzisa amaxabiso omsebenzi kuphela, uze uchaze isizathu sokuba ifomyula engalunganga ibonakale ichanekile ngengozi kwiphuzu elinye.
y-m-68-06.material:
Abafundi ababini bafumana inkcazelo ye-f(x) = x^x (x > 0). (Funda: x kumandla e-x.)
Umfundi A: "Umandla yi-x, ngoko kwi-(x^n)′ = n·x^(n−1), faka x endaweni ye-n, kwaye f′(x) = x·x^(x−1) = x^x."
Umfundi B: "Ukuthatha i-logarithm yendalo yamacala omabini, ln f = x·ln x, kwaye ukwahlula kunika f′/f = ln x + 1, ngoko f′(x) = x^x·(ln x + 1)."
Ukuhlola ukuba ngowuphi olungileyo, umlinganiselo ophakathi wotshintsho kwi-x = 1, (f(1.001) − f(1)) / 0.001, wafunyanwa ngekhalkyuleyitha kwaye waphuma malunga ne-1.0010.

y-m-68-05.topic: Iindlela zokudibanisa: ukuhlola isithuba sokudibanisa emva kokutshintsha ukuya kunobumba omtsha kwi-integral echanekileyo
y-m-68-05.goal: Fumana umgca apho isithuba sahamba kakubi kwisisombululo esigqityiweyo, gweba ukuba zombini ukwahlula isithuba nokubala ngexesha elinye zisemthethweni, uze ucoce ixabiso elingalunganga ngoqikelelo ngaphandle kokubala.
y-m-68-05.material: Umfundi wasombulula i-integral echanekileyo ∫ x·e^(x²) dx (ukusuka ku-x = −1 ukuya ku-2) kwimigca emi-4 engezantsi. (Funda: x amaxesha e eya kwisikhuphi se-x isikwere, dx.) Njengesalathiso, e ≈ 2.718.
y-m-68-05.thinking.1: Thelekisa ukuba izisombululo ezimbini ezahlukeneyo zisemthethweni

y-m-68-05.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca omnye kwisisombululo somfundi apho kuhamba kakubi kuqala. (Eminye imigca inokubala okuchanekileyo.)

y-m-68-05.s.s1.hint.1: Fumana amaxabiso amancinci nakhulu kakhulu e-u = x² njengoko i-x ihamba isuka ku-−1 iye ku-2, uze uwathelekise noluhlu lwe-u olusetyenziswe kwisisombululo.
y-m-68-05.s.s1.line.0: Ukuvumela u = x², sifumana du = 2x dx, ngoko x dx = (1/2) du.
y-m-68-05.s.s1.line.1: I-x itshintsha isuka ku-−1 iye ku-2, ngoko i-u nayo itshintsha isuka ku-−1 iye ku-2.
y-m-68-05.s.s1.line.2: Ngoko i-integral echanekileyo enikiweyo yi-integral echanekileyo ye-(1/2)·e^u du ukusuka ku-u = −1 ukuya ku-2.
y-m-68-05.s.s1.explain: Ngumgca 2. Kuba u = x², xa x = −1, u = 1, yaye xa x = 2, u = 4. Ngaphandle koko, x² ubuncinane ngu-0, ngoko u-u akanakuba ngu-−1. Ukuba utshintsha isithuba sibe ngamaxabiso e-u, ufumana (1/2)[e^u] (ukusuka ku-u = 1 ukuya ku-4) = (e⁴ − e)/2. Umgca 1 uchanekile, yaye imigca 3 nowe-4 ziziphumo ezilandela isithuba somgca 2.
y-m-68-05.s.s2.prompt: Omnye umfundi uthe oku: "x² iyehla isuka ku-x = −1 ukuya ku-0 yaye iyanyuka isuka ku-0 ukuya ku-2, ngoko ayihambi ngecala elinye kuphela. Ngoko awunako ukutshintshela ku-u = 1 ukuya ku-4 ngexesha elinye, yaye kufuneka wahlule isithuba ku-x = 0." Ukubala ngokwahlula kunika (1 − e)/2 + (e⁴ − 1)/2, yaye ukutshintsha ngexesha elinye kunika (e⁴ − e)/2, yaye amaxabiso omabini ayalingana. Khetha umgwebo ofanelekileyo ngale meko.
y-m-68-05.s.s2.hint.0: Thelekisa apho ixabiso le-u ku-x = 0 (elingu-0) lisetyenziswa khona kwiindlela ezimbini.
y-m-68-05.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala ngokwakho ukuba kwenzeka ntoni kumagama e^0 xa wahlula uze udibanise.
y-m-68-05.s.s2.o.a: Ukuhambelana kwamaxabiso asuka ekutshintsheni konke ngaxeshanye bekukungengozi, ngoko indlela engahluli isithuba iyaphosakala.
y-m-68-05.s.s2.r.a: Ixabiso elifanayo asingozi. Intetho inefom ethi e^u iphindaphindwe ngezinga loshintsho lwe-u (2x), ngoko iindlela ezimbini zakhelwe ukunika ixabiso elifanayo.
y-m-68-05.s.s2.o.b: Ukuba i-u ayihambi ngecala elinye kuphela, le integral echanekileyo ayinakusonjululwa ngokutshintshela ku-u.
